title: overlay: fall back to diff dir size when XFS quota lookup fails
body:
ReadWriteDiskUsage only consulted the XFS quota controller and returned its error directly. When the quota lookup fails, fall back to sizing the "diff" directory, and only surface an error when the fallback also fails, joining both errors so the original quota failure is preserved.

I noticed the discrepancy between the comment and the code by reading it, I didn't run into this issue in a live environment.

comments.body:
OTOH, uh… `ReadWriteDiskUsage` has no `store`-level API (and no user in Podman), the only way to reach it is to via `store.GraphDriver()` — as CRI-O does.

But that also means it is completely bypassing the c/storage locking :/
